title: qtip holder
text: qtip holder. The first one I ordered was broken and wouldn't lock down.... returned and reordered and this one works perfectly.  It's small.  You don't want to overload it or you'll pull out all the qtips as you're trying to get just one.  It is separated into 4 sections -  I put the regular qtips in two of the sections and then my makeup qtips that have the pointy ends in the other 2 sections.  Works for me.  You pull the top round top off, fill it, replace the round top and press it down.  It's stays closed until you lightly press it, then a spring opens it.  Handy.  It is a soft white plastic except for a clear section at the top where you can see the qtips.

description: **MB Cotton Swabs Holder is unique among other Q-tip jars and dispensers on the market. Its clever design combines the best features of a jar and a dispenser. Like a jar, it seals the swabs off to protect the cotton tip. But like a dispenser, the q-tips are easy to retrieve without your hand touching the cotton tips. ** Compact in size (2.5 inch diameter, 4.25 inch height), it nonetheless holds about 80 q-tips. **This clear organizer allows you to eliminate clutter, keep bathroom neat and save space. It won't clash with the decor of your home or office and makes a beautiful display. ** The transparent design of MB Cotton Swabs Holder allows you to see when you’re running out of essential items so you know when to refill them and also make it easy to locate essential items.
